tools.name: find_available_providers
tools.description: Find a person to do something in a named place, and say which of them are ACTUALLY FREE RIGHT NOW. Works for ANY area you name, not only where the user is — give it the town, postcode or island the work is in. A property, client, guest or relative somewhere else is a normal case. Speedi is not a dir

tools.name: check_provider_availability
tools.description: Check whether one specific named business is free right now on Speedi, and when they last set their availability. Use this when someone names a business rather than a trade.
